name: Captain's Quarters Lounge
description: Captain's Quarters is a lively karaoke venue known for its friendly atmosphere and diverse entertainment options. It offers karaoke nights most nights of the week, with a welcoming crowd that enjoys singing along to a wide song library. The venue features a good sound system, attentive staff, and a casual vibe perfect for both casual nights out and private celebrations. Food and drinks are available, making it a full-service spot for fun and relaxation.
